mapper.select: SELECT cm.cost_id, cm.cost_no, cm.cycle_id, cc.cycle_code, cc.cycle_name, cm.dept_id, d.dept_code, d.dept_name, cm.element_type, cm.cost_amount, cm.occur_date, cm.pay_type, cm.remark, cm.create_user, cm.create_time, cm.update_time FROM cost_main cm LEFT JOIN cost_cycle cc ON cm.cycle_id = cc.cycle_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON cm.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE cm.cost_id = #{id}

SELECT cm.cost_id, cm.cost_no, cm.cycle_id, cc.cycle_code, cc.cycle_name, cm.dept_id, d.dept_code, d.dept_name, cm.element_type, cm.cost_amount, cm.occur_date, cm.pay_type, cm.remark, cm.create_user, cm.create_time, cm.update_time FROM cost_main cm LEFT JOIN cost_cycle cc ON cm.cycle_id = cc.cycle_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON cm.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE cm.cost_no = #{costNo}

SELECT cm.cost_id, cm.cost_no, cm.cycle_id, cc.cycle_code, cc.cycle_name, cm.dept_id, d.dept_code, d.dept_name, cm.element_type, cm.cost_amount, cm.occur_date, cm.pay_type, cm.remark, cm.create_user, cm.create_time, cm.update_time FROM cost_main cm LEFT JOIN cost_cycle cc ON cm.cycle_id = cc.cycle_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON cm.dept_id = d.dept_id ORDER BY cm.create_time DESC
SELECT MAX(cost_no) FROM cost_main WHERE cost_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cost_main (cost_no, cycle_id, dept_id, element_type, cost_amount, occur_date, pay_type, remark, create_user, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{costNo}, #{cycleId}, #{deptId}, #{elementType}, #{costAmount}, #{occurDate}, #{payType}, #{remark}, #{createUser}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE cost_main SET cycle_id = #{cycleId}, dept_id = #{deptId}, element_type = #{elementType}, cost_amount = #{costAmount}, occur_date = #{occurDate}, pay_type = #{payType}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE cost_id = #{costId}
